snippet.title: Shion | New Hero Gameplay Trailer | Overwatch
snippet.description:
You don’t become the leader of the Hashimoto by playing it safe.

Introducing Shion - the newest hitscan Damage Hero joining the roster and the next major player in the Reign of Talon.

Armed with dual semi-auto pistols, an omnidirectional dash, and a motorcycle she can throw, Shion thrives in dangerous situations with nothing to lose and everything to gain.

Join her as she paints the town red when Season 3: Into the Tiger’s Den launches on June 16.

Overwatch is free to play on PC and console, now including Nintendo Switch™ 2"!
_

snippet.title: Gatto | Teaser Trailer | In Theaters March 5, 2027
snippet.description:
Ciao Gatto
Watch the new teaser for Disney & Pixar's #Gatto, arriving in theaters March 5, 2027

Mark Ruffalo (“Poor Things,” “The Avengers,” “Spotlight, “Foxcatcher”) has joined the voice cast as the scrappy black cat Nero, and Laurence Fishburne (“The Matrix” trilogy, “Boyz n the Hood,” “What's Love Got to Do with It”) will voice the ruthless mob boss cat Rocco. The teaser trailer introduces Nero and Rocco as they question another cat in a funny interrogation scene.
In “Gatto,” after years of maneuvering the canal-ridden, superstitious city of Venice, Italy, Nero begins to question whether he’s lived the right lives. Indebted to Rocco, the local feline mob boss, Nero finds himself in a quandary and is forced to forge a truly unexpected friendship that may finally lead him to his purpose—unless Venice gets the better of him first.
“Gatto” is directed by Enrico Casarosa and produced by Andrea Warren, the filmmaking team behind the Oscar®-nominated feature “Luca.” The new film releases exclusively in theaters March 5, 2027.

ABOUT PIXAR ANIMATION STUDIOS
Pixar Animation Studios, a wholly owned subsidiary of The Walt Disney Company, is an Academy Award®-winning film studio with world-renowned technical, creative and production capabilities in the art of computer animation. The Northern California studio has created some of the most successful and beloved animated films of all time, including “Toy Story,” “Monsters, Inc.,” “Cars,” “The Incredibles,” “Ratatouille,” “WALL•E,” “Up,” “Brave,” “Inside Out,” “Coco,” “Soul,” “Turning Red,” “Elemental,” and “Inside Out 2.”

Every revolution begins with a reckoning.
 
The Social Reckoning, a companion piece to The Social Network, is coming exclusively to theatres October 9.

THE SOCIAL RECKONING
Dramatic Thriller
October 9, 2026

A companion piece to the hit film The Social Network, Sorkin’s original screenplay is based on the events that gave rise to the Wall Street Journal’s shocking exposé The Facebook Files. The film is inspired by the true story of how Frances Haugen (Madison), a young Facebook engineer, enlists the help of Jeff Horwitz (White), a Wall Street Journal reporter, to go on a dangerous journey that ends up blowing the whistle on the social network’s most guarded secrets.

snippet.description:
Welcome to the newest chapter of the YRF Spy Universe that presents an edgy origin story of a girl raised and built to kill. Alpha is a female-led action film that will take you on a fun, edge of the seat, thrilling ride that is designed as an out and out entertainer.

Yash Raj Films presents Alpha, starring Alia Bhatt, Sharvari, Anil Kapoor, and Bobby Deol. Produced by Aditya Chopra and directed by Shiv Rawail, acclaimed for the globally celebrated series The Railway Men, Alpha is set to release in theatres worldwide on July 3, 2026.

About YRF Spy Universe:
YRF Spy Universe is a first of its kind cinematic universe of spy thriller films in India. The first film in the universe, "Ek Tha Tiger", starring Salman Khan and Katrina Kaif was released in 2012, followed by its sequel "Tiger Zinda Hai" in 2017. The third film in the universe, "War" was released in 2019 and starred Hrithik Roshan and Tiger Shroff in pivotal roles. "Pathaan" was the fourth instalment in the Spy Universe franchise which was released in 2023 starring Shah Rukh Khan, Deepika Padukone and John Abraham. "Tiger 3", the fifth instalment in the YRF Spy Universe and the third film in the Tiger series, starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif and Emraan Hashmi, released in 2023. "War 2", the sixth film in the YRF Spy Universe, starring Hrithik Roshan, NTR and Kiara Advani, directed by Ayan Mukerji, released on 14 August 2025. "Alpha", the seventh film in the franchise and Hindi cinema’s first female-led YRF Spy Universe film, starring Alia Bhatt and Sharvari, will release on 3 July 2026.

Oh kaisi dilkashi

Mere humnasheen… hmmmm

Tu jaisay meri pari
Masoomiyut chulkay teri
Baatoun se kitni…hayee
Saada si jo adaa’ein teri

Dil ki meri

Yaadein jo rahi na meri

Khwaboun mein mere hai tu hi basi

Tera sharmana, meri jaana kabhi

snippet.title: XIT KODDI (Official Music Video) - Black Sapphire | Alison Gonsalves | Konkani Song 2026
snippet.description:
Xit Koddi – An Original Konkani Song by Alison Gonsalves & Black Sapphire
Our staple food deserved a song, so we made one.
An ode to Goa’s beloved staple meal, Xit Koddi (Goan fish curry rice), and the emotion every Goan connects with, no matter where they are in the world.

From traditional Goan kitchens and paddy fields to friends sharing a simple meal, Xit Koddi reflects the warmth, friendship, unity, and togetherness that have always been part of Goa’s culture.

▶ Watch in 4K for the best experience.

snippet.title: AGBE & Magdalena Narożna - Money Money ( Official Video) 2026
snippet.description:
Koncerty Booking - AGBE
666 034 970, e-mail: bryszardtiktok@gmail.com
Booking & Współpraca: Magdalena Narożna
STARSIDE Agency - agencja artystyczna
+48 608 238 138
booking@pimofficial.pl
wspolpraca@pimofficial.pl
www.starside.pl 

„Od dawna śledziłyśmy swoją twórczość i wiedziałyśmy, że mimo własnych muzycznych dróg mamy podobną energię oraz wrażliwość. Obie wywodzimy się ze sceny muzyki tanecznej i zawsze stawiałyśmy na autentyczność oraz kontakt z ludźmi. Kiedy pojawił się pomysł na „Money Money”, od razu poczułyśmy, że to temat, o którym chcemy opowiedzieć wspólnie.”

Skąd pomysł na taki utwór?

„Money Money to historia inspirowana życiem i doświadczeniami, które zna wiele kobiet. To utwór o relacjach, w których uczucia schodzą na dalszy plan, a na pierwszym miejscu pojawiają się pieniądze, korzyści i własne ego. Chciałyśmy pokazać, że miłość nie powinna być traktowana jak transakcja, w której jedna strona ciągle daje, a druga tylko bierze. To także przestroga przed materialistami i narcyzami oraz przypomnienie, że prawdziwe relacje buduje się na szacunku, szczerości i wzajemności.”

Muzyka i Słowa: AGBE ,Magdalena Narożna
Mastering : Krupek
Produkcja teledysku: Bryszard

snippet.description:
We’re taking it back to the streets. The Fast and the Furious returns to theaters August 21. Tickets available now

About The Fast and The Furious:
They've got the adrenaline rush and the mean machines, but most of all, they've got the extreme need for speed. On the turbo-charged streets of Los Angeles, every night is a championship race. With nitro-boosted fury, Dominic Toretto (Vin Diesel), rules the road turning all his challengers into dust. He and his rival, Johnny Tran (Rick Yune) are the boldest, the baddest and the best. But now, there's new rage on the road. They know he's tough, they know he's fast, but what they don't know is that he's a speed demon detective (Paul Walker) with enough drive and determination to come out the winner. With intense full-throttle action, awesome high-speed stunts, and full-on pedal to the metal intensity, this fast and furious assault puts you in the driver's seat and dares you to exceed all limits.

snippet.title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day | TV SPOT “POWER” | Marvel Studios
snippet.description:
#SpiderMan #SpiderManBrandNewDay #Marvel

► Spider-Man: Brand New Day | NEW TV SPOT CONCEPT | Marvel Studios

A Brand New Day begins.

Here’s our TV Spot concept for SPIDER-MAN: BRAND NEW DAY, the next theatrical chapter for Peter Parker and Spider-Man. More information about the video down below!

Story and inspiration in the video:

Spider-Man: Brand New Day follows Peter Parker as he continues his life alone in a New York City that no longer knows his name. With the world forgetting Peter’s identity, he has fully committed himself to being Spider-Man, protecting the city while carrying the weight of everything he lost.

As the pressure on Spider-Man continues to grow, Peter faces a new chapter that pushes him physically and emotionally, leading to a surprising evolution that threatens his very existence.

Directed by Destin Daniel Cretton and starring Tom Holland, Zendaya, Sadie Sink, Spider-Man: Brand New Day swings into theaters July 31, 2026.

snippet.title: NIMRODS - A Green Day Comedy | Official Trailer - In Theaters on August 14th
snippet.description:
The official Nimrods trailer is here, and the Analog Dogs are opening for us apparently...  

Can’t wait for you to see this in theaters on August 14!!!

ABOUT NIMRODS

When Tommy receives a phone call inviting his band to open for Green Day on New Years Eve, he doesn’t realize it’s an elaborate prank by his older brother, Wayne. Desperate to believe his life is about to change, Tommy steals Wayne's car and begins driving his band from Kansas City to Los Angeles, hell bent on getting there in three days. What follows is a rowdy and uproarious road trip across America, inspired by Green Day’s early days of touring in a van, years before the release of their breakout record Dookie. 

Starring: Mason Thames, Kylr Coffman, Ryan Foust, and Mckenna Grace.

Also Starring: Jenna Fischer, Angela Kinsey,  Fred Armisen, Bobby Lee, Jolene, Keen Ruffalo, Ignacio Diaz-Silverio,  Sean Gunn, 

With Green Day: Billie Joe Armstrong, Mike Dirnt, and Tré Cool.

Written & Directed by Lee Kirk. 

Produced by Green Day.

https://greenday.com/

snippet.title: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis - The First Preview
snippet.description:
At its core, the design of Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, the remake or "reimagining" of the 1996 original, attempts to blend the classic feel of Lara Croft’s movement with a more modern approach to combat and exploration.

You know what Tomb Raider is. Chances are you’ve played on one of Lara Croft’s many adventures, or at least one of the cinematic action-adventures that her original 1996 expedition inspired, whether that be the Uncharted, Horizon, or Star Wars Jedi series. But now it’s time to go all the way back, as Legacy of Atlantis takes us full circle in a reimagining of the story that kick-started a genre.

#IGN #TombRaiderLegacyOfAtlantis #Preview

📅 Fecha de Lanzamiento | 16/06/2009
🔊 Géneros Musicales | Rock

✨ Acerca de la Canción:
"Zombie" de The Cranberries es una poderosa canción de protesta que habla sobre el dolor, la violencia y las heridas que dejan los conflictos armados en la sociedad. Con una letra cargada de emoción y una interpretación inolvidable de Dolores O'Riordan, el tema refleja el sufrimiento de las víctimas inocentes y cuestiona el ciclo interminable de odio y destrucción. Su mensaje sigue siendo tan impactante y relevante hoy como cuando fue lanzada.

snippet.title: ICE CITY | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
ICE CITY | Official Trailer

Set against the backdrop of modern London culture, Ice City explores friendship, pressure, street politics, family, and the choices people make when they are trying to rise above their circumstances.

What starts as ambition soon becomes a test of loyalty, as each character is forced to decide who they really are, who they can trust, and how far they are willing to go.

Raw, stylish, and character-driven, Ice City captures the energy of London youth culture through sharp dialogue, music, fashion, humour, and tension. It is not just about conflict, but about identity, brotherhood, legacy, and the cost of chasing power in a city that does not give second chances.

For better days

Don't leave me behind

Still lives in the seams
Come back and stay

Please stay with me

Still dusty from that night

Still says the words you said

Come back and stay
Don't make me wait
I kept the door unlocked
I kept the faith

Come back and stay

Please stay
Don't leave me behind

Everything we had together
Still lives in the seams
Come back and stay

Please stay with me

One more chance

Don't leave me behind

Come back and stay

Please stay with me

snippet.title: A NEW Warlock Build That's ABSURDLY STRONG.. Enjoy! [Destiny 2 Warlock Build]
snippet.description:
YOUTUBE MEMBER:
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCIyCSH_pqV_wOzVYm8s9Hkw/join

A NEW Warlock Build That's ABSURDLY STRONG.. Enjoy! [Destiny 2 Warlock Build]

I just need you guys to watch what I do because this Warlock Build is just absurd. Normally there is some sort of draw back when something is this powerful, maybe it doesn't have Good AOE AD clear or maybe you can't spam the ability. Maybe you can't survive in close combat or maybe the melee doesn't have any range at all... Maybe you need to use Monte Carlo to get your melee back, Well as you can see I built this Warlock to have infinite melees so we aren't tied to an exotic weapon which is crazy
I'm here to say that this Vampire Warlock defies all of that and is by far one of the Best Builds in Destiny 2. 

We set the artifact mods up and the mods on our gear to help us loop the melee ability over and over. Our exotic gives us a ton of damage. Then our subclass pulls it all together with more melee regen and crowd control to create the perfect Void Lock Vampire that we have always wanted in destiny 2. You one shot champions even 30 power level under in Ultimate difficulty and you can quite literally spam this new soul siphon ability. It can kill entire groups or waves of enemies. It gives us full void over shields and we get devour on top of that. We also suppress everything for even more survivability.

There really isn't a negative when it comes to this Void Vamp Lock and I'm excited for you all to set it up and give it a try!

The most important thing is being able to loop your melee ability if we want to take advantage of Soul Siphon as much as we can. 

I wanted to accomplish this without using Monte Carlo since there are just so many fun Exotics and I don't like to be tied to one.

But of course feel free to use it if you want. 

So how do we accomplish this? There are 3 Artifact mods that we pair with our second Aspect that do the job for us.

The most important thing is being able to loop your melee ability if we want to take advantage of Soul Siphon as much as we can. 

I wanted to accomplish this without using Monte Carlo since there are just so many fun Exotics and I don't like to be tied to one.

But of course feel free to use it if you want. 

So how do we accomplish this? There are 3 Artifact mods that we pair with our second Aspect that do the job for us.

snippet.title: Disabling Weapon Swapping Completely Changes GTA V
snippet.description:
I tried to beat GTA V without ever switching weapons, meaning I was permanently stuck using whatever weapon the game forced into my hands. What sounds like a simple challenge quickly turned into a bizarre test of GTA mechanics, mission scripting, speedrun strats, forced loadouts, vehicle weapons, cutscene weapon grants, impossible setups, and moments where the game simply refused to give me what I needed. From losing basic movement tricks to discovering strange mission edge cases and nearly softlocking the run, this challenge made Grand Theft Auto V feel less like an action game and more like a broken puzzle where every weapon mattered.

snippet.title: TOMB RAIDER REMAKE First Gameplay Reveal | MOST ICONIC NEW LARA CROFT Legacy of Atlantis Adventure
snippet.description:
Check out this new early gameplay demo preview from the upcoming Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis, developed by Crystal Dynamics in partnership with Flying Wild Hog in Unreal Engine 5. This work-in-progress footage has been provided by Amazon and edited by us. This new title marks the highly anticipated return to the absolute pinnacle of action adventure exploration. Preserving the acclaimed atmosphere of the 1996 original, this remake delivers a brand-new direction that drastically expands the game's scale into dangerous, long-forgotten corners of the world while heightening the sense of isolated exploration and tactical puzzle-solving fans have craved for decades. If you love the vibe of classic 90s platformers and modern adventures, you will find your perfect sweet spot here. Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is the ultimate love letter to adventure fans, seamlessly blending the exploration of Star Wars Jedi, the cinematic thrill of Uncharted, the acrobatic combat of Prince of Persia, and the isolated soul of the 1996 original.

00:00 PC Gameplay
02:50 PS5 Pro
06:25 Developers talk about the game
13:33 Unreal Engine 5
14:17 Motion Capture

✒️ DESCRIPTION

Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis moves away from the gritty origins of the recent trilogy and introduces a completely reimagined, faithful take on Lara Croft's very first legendary adventure. The story follows the iconic, seasoned archaeologist Lara Croft (voiced by Alix Wilton Regan) as she is hired to find pieces of an ancient artifact known as the Scion. Her quest begins in a storm-ravaged, hidden jungle valley in Peru, but quickly uncovers a catastrophic connection to the mythical, sunken empire of Atlantis. Stranded amidst fierce wildlife, ancient traps, and deadly mercenaries hired by a rival corporation, Lara must navigate a relentless game of pure survival and discovery within oppressive underground ruins and breathtaking lost worlds.

💥 GAMEPLAY FEATURES AND FIRST IMPRESSIONS

- New Unified Lara Croft: The game features a new stunning character model built in Unreal Engine 5. Rather than repeating the raw, vulnerable look of the recent survivor trilogy, this modern design acts as a unified vision. Lara sports her iconic classic attire but reimagined with highly detailed, realistic textures. Her facial design strikingely bridges the gap between her 90s look and her modern iterations. Furthermore, the performance by Alix Wilton Regan perfectly captures Lara’s traditional, highly confident, and witty aristocratic persona, a refreshing return to her classic roots.

- Authentic Balance of Classic and Modern: The game perfectly merges old-school game feel with modern technology. Traversal features a distinct, deliberate weight and a slight floatiness to Lara's jumps that requires precise timing, making every successfully crossed chasm feel like a monumental achievement.

- Unguided Exploration: The scale of the environments is significantly expanded, focusing heavily on isolation. The famous Lost Valley area features zero waypoint markers or glowing yellow paint to guide you. Players must rely entirely on exploration, finding mechanical cogs to unlock massive ancient doors, and utilizing Lara’s high-tech scanner to discover hidden pathways, crafting materials, and lore collectibles.

- Revamped Acrobatic Combat and New Focus System: While Lara wields her iconic dual pistols (featuring unlimited ammo and their signature booming sound design), combat abandons the standard lock-on mechanics of the past. The game introduces a Focus Gauge: by performing classic gymnastic maneuvers (such as backflips, side-rolls, and cartwheels to dodge enemies) Lara builds focus. Activating it triggers a stylish slow-motion flip, allowing players to target critical weak spots on aggressive wildlife like the velociraptors.

- T-Rex Cinematic Tension: There's is an intense, camera-shifting chase sequence involving the legendary T-Rex. The gameplay seamlessly transitions into cinematic peril, requiring players to perform precise slides under the dinosaur's legs. One wrong move results in a brutal, instant failure, perfectly capturing the danger of the original game.

- Difficulty Customization: To grant players total agency over their experience, the game allows for fully independent difficulty scaling. You can set combat to be highly forgiving while turning environmental puzzles into a brutal, unguided mental challenge.

✅ RELEASE DATE AND PLATFORMS

Coming February 12, 2027, to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S, PC (Steam), and Nintendo Switch 2. The Deluxe Edition includes 48-hour early access ahead of the full release.

🕹️ SUPPORT THE DEVELOPERS

Wishlist/Buy on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3558670/Tomb_Raider_Legacy_of_Atlantis/

📩 FOR DEVELOPERS

Want your game featured? Reach out to us via the "About" section of our channel. We do gameplay previews and compilations every day!
